laws.rule: Kigali Genocide Memorial: outdoor photography/filming is permitted, but photography INSIDE the museum is not. Professional media must obtain government filming permission and press accreditation as described by the Memorial. Do not turn the outdoor permission into consent to photograph other visitors or ceremonies.

Kigali Genocide Memorial: children under 12 are not permitted. Dress and behave respectfully; do not walk on mass graves. No eating/drinking in gardens or exhibition, with the café separately available. Pets excluded, service animals permitted. Entrance screening applies. These are named-site conditions, not all Kigali public spaces.

local-law.note: The Memorial is a final resting place. No live opening or blanket community-consent inference.

closures: Kigali Genocide Memorial: daily 09:00-17:00, last entry 16:00. On the last Saturday of the month (Umuganda), opens 13:00-17:00. Closed 25 December and 1 January; normally closed the morning of 7 April for the start of Kwibuka. Confirm date-specific access.

culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Kigali Genocide Memorial operator for this memorial site; wider community ceremony permissions not yet checked.
culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Dress and behave respectfully, do not step on mass graves, and observe the Memorial's age, food/drink and screening conditions.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Outdoor photos allowed; indoor museum photography prohibited. Professional media need government filming permission and press accreditation. Respect other visitors; a ticket or outdoor-photography allowance is not individual/community storytelling consent.
